policy.principle: A repair is incomplete until the incident is converted into a permanent system invariant, implemented in the canonical path, regression-tested, enforced by CI, governed through release admission, and recorded in durable repair and advancement ledgers.

repairs.incident: Hybrid/bootstrap and legacy Windows entrypoints could diver or create parallel runtime/agent ownership.
repairs.invariant: For one approved root, OMEGA has one canonical localhost runtime, one sovereign outbound agent, one authenticated Hybrid session and one bounded local execution-authority lease; legacy entrypoints delegate or fail closed.
repairs.authority_boundary: Source proof grants no Canon, deployment, promotion or physical execution authority; exact-head release-forward admission remains authoritative.
repairs.release_admission: CANDIDATE until exact-head governed merge, deployment and live acceptance complete.

repairs.authority_boundary: Correct CI setup establishes source/process proof only and grants no deployment or promotion authority.
repairs.release_admission: CANDIDATE until governed exact-head source and production admission complete.
